steps.text: STEP 1: Set the values of resistances R1, R2, R3 and RL using the sliders before making any circuit connections.
CASE 1. Measure RTH. Short circuit terminals 9 and 10. Connect the Multimeter between terminals 5 and 11, and 6 and 13. Click the CHECK button to verify the connections.
If the connections are correct, click the ADD button to record the RTH value in the observation table. Then remove the connections by clicking the corresponding terminal labels.
CASE 2. Measure VTH. Connect the Power Supply between terminals 7 and 9, and 8 and 10. Connect the Voltmeter between terminals 1 and 11, and 2 and 13. Click CHECK to verify the connections.
Turn ON the Power Supply and adjust the voltage using the slider. Click ADD to record the VTH value. Then remove the voltmeter connections by clicking the corresponding terminal labels.

CASE 3. Measure IL. Connect the Power Supply between terminals 7 and 9, and 8 and 10. Connect the Ammeter between terminals 3 and 11, 4 and 12, and short circuit terminals 13 and 14. Click CHECK to verify the connections.
Turn ON the Power Supply and adjust the voltage. Click ADD to record the IL value in the observation table.
Click the CALCULATE button to calculate the Load Current using the measured values of RTH and VTH.
Enter the manually calculated Load Current value in the calculation section and click VERIFY to compare it with the experimental value.
Click the PRINT button to print the experiment report.
Click the RESET button to restart the experiment and clear all observations and connections.
